method: Same aec09d6 core source four-run two-lifetime ABBA original-A/candidate-B/candidate-B2/original-A2. Both one/native bank, current mask and peak, same allocation/raster/draw/upload/artist code; only the complete CardRasterCache class module differs at the exact current PaintedCardBatches import. Budget-only complete-class policy: sole source difference is constructor default 48MiB to16MiB. Codec/get/put/clear/stats/admission/backoff algorithm bytes are otherwise unchanged; no ghost or probation fields. Cache and CPU ownership/cost changes are reported, not asserted equal. GPU rasterization/upload/copy counts, page layout, geometry and render order remain strict invariants. All raw samples pooled across four lifetimes per policy, not selected or averaged quantiles. All 24 PNGs are decoded and compared at zero RGBA tolerance; original-A supplies six phase/lifetime image oracles.

cacheMetadataAccounting.reason: Neither class implements probation or admission metadata; absent raw fields remain absent, and validation fields are null/not applicable. Existing encoded-entry Map/key/object metadata and process memory are not measured by declared buffer ownership.

limits: ABBA preserves all four lifetimes/240CPU/48real per policy. Balance reduces simple order drift but does not prove stable tails or hardware-independent speed. Cold first and slow lifetimes are not selected out. Complete wall is GPU-completion/scheduling, not GPU nanoseconds/FPS.

Budget-only constructor-default policy is tested on aec09d6, not integrated production and not the entire historical renderer. Budget-dependent cache counters, true Canvas misses and CPU ownership may differ. No probation/admission/ghost stats exist; validation fields must be absent or null as specified, not invented zeros. Encoded entries are capped at1024; existing JS entry metadata bytes remain unmeasured. Stage/cache work costs are cumulative, not only timed CPU rows; avoidedPaintMs is an estimate, not measured total frame benefit.
Full/World3D/Canvas timings are nested/residual and cannot be added. Cold real samples remain in headline values. No allocation profiler or GC attribution.
